source.title: Mnzil Karachi route finder: station and vehicle pages
source.licence: none stated; all rights reserved by Cheeltech. Included with attribution on the project owner's decision (unofficial source).

method: Station list from https://mnzil.app/api/sitemap (station/ URLs). Each station page (https://mnzil.app/station/<slug>) embeds stationData {id, name_english, latitude, longitude, slug} and vehiclesData (vehicles serving the station) in its Next.js RSC payload. Each vehicle page (https://mnzil.app/vehicles/<slug>) embeds stationsData in route order. Both were fetched at about 1 request per second (152 vehicle pages on 2026-09-23 by an earlier pass, reused from its scratch cache; 600 station pages on 2026-09-24) and merged by Mnzil station id. seq = 1-based position(s) of the station in that vehicle's stationsData list. Coordinates are Mnzil's own (not OSM); treat them as a reference / geocoding hint, not as coord_source-grade data under SCHEMA.md.

Coordinate errors in Mnzil: "PMTF - Jumma Goth" has longitude 6725409355624929 (decimal point lost; almost certainly 67.25409355624929) - kept raw and flagged outside_karachi_bbox. "Soorty Factory" is at 67.649 E, about 30 km east of Port Qasim; check before use.
route_detail.seq null + listed_on_station_page_only: the station page names the vehicle but the vehicle page's stationsData does not include that station (Mnzil internal inconsistency).
Mnzil vehicles M-5 (1 station: Expo Center), MK-081 and P-1 (0 stations) and 4-E (0 stations) have no usable station list; the Expo Center station page does not list M-5.

vehicles[].our_routes maps each Mnzil vehicle to our data/systems route ids: by the Mnzil URL in the route sources, else by normalised route number within karachi-minibus (type 4) or karachi-chinchi (types 3, 6). PBS/EV/DD and BRT were mapped by hand.
